[Header]
Target = AHAB
Version = 2.0 # hybrid container

[Install SRK]
# SRK table array generated by srktool
File = "./release/crts/SRK_1_2_3_4_table.bin"
# Public key certificate in PEM format
Source = "./release/crts/SRK1_sha384_p384_mldsa65_v3_ca_crt.pem"
# Index of the public key certificate within the SRK table (0 .. 3)
Source index = 0
# Type of SRK set (NXP or OEM)
Source set = OEM
# bitmask of the revoked SRKs
Revocations = 0x0
# Signature verification policy
Check All Signatures = All

[Authenticate Data]
# Binary to be signed generated by mkimage
File = "flash.bin"
# Offsets = Container header  Signature block (printed out by mkimage)
Offsets   = 0x8000             0x8290
